title: polygala paniculata var. normalis
intro: Polygala paniculata var. normalis, commonly known as Yuan Zhi, is a plant species belonging to the Polygalaceae family, native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as improving sleep quality and reducing stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Yuan Zhi are attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Yuan Zhi include polygalic acid, polygalin, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional Chinese medicine to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety.
